subject: Ghanaian Language
name: Basic 5 Ghanaian Language
description: The Basic 5 Ghanaian Language curriculum focuses on advanced oral language skills, reading comprehension, and fluency. It includes the study of traditional songs, poems, folktales, and drama, as well as developing vocabulary and phonics knowledge.

strands.title: Oral Language (Listening and Speaking)
strands.description: Enhancing listening and speaking skills through various oral art forms and daily interactions.

subStrands.title: Songs
subStrands.description: Understanding and performing cradle songs and lullabies.

contentStandards.description: Show an understanding of cradle songs/lullaby

indicators.description: Sing cradle songs/lullaby with the correct rhythms and discuss importance of cradle songs/lullaby to the baby, mother and caretaker

exemplars.description: Show a clip of a baby crying and discuss what a mother does.
Play a recorded cradle song and lead learners to sing with correct rhythm.
Discuss the importance of lullabies (e.g., makes baby sleep, allows mother to work).
Role-play a mother singing a lullaby.

subStrands.title: Poems
subStrands.description: Exploring poems and understanding their themes.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of selected poems by discussing them

indicators.description: Explore a poem of about six to seven lines correctly

exemplars.description: Listen to a poem accompanied by audio and perform gestures.
Lead learners to explore poems correctly.

indicators.description: Recognise the key words in the poem and discuss the theme of the poem

exemplars.description: Listen to a poem recital and discuss key issues.
Identify key words in the poem.
Discuss the theme of the poem in groups.

subStrands.title: Listening and Story Telling
subStrands.description: Retelling folktales and understanding their structure.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge on the structure and features of folktales

indicators.description: Retell a folktale of about five scenes and discuss the moral/values of it

exemplars.description: Discuss evening activities and folktales.
Tell a folktale and allow learners to retell it.
Discuss the structure and moral lessons of the folktale.

indicators.description: Recognise the characters in the folktales

exemplars.description: Identify characters in a folktale told by a learner.
Write briefly on the identified characters.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate an understanding of how a story can be changed into a drama

indicators.description: Narrate a story of about six to seven characters and recognise the characters, setting and stage

exemplars.description: Read a story and discuss unfamiliar words.
Discuss key considerations in changing a story to a drama.
Identify characters, setting, and costumes for the drama.

indicators.description: Perform a drama of about six to seven characters

exemplars.description: Revise the features of a drama.
Direct learners to perform a drama piece based on the storyline.

subStrands.title: Conversation
subStrands.description: Discussing items used at home and school.

contentStandards.description: Name and discuss some basic items used at home and in school

indicators.description: Recognise and discuss items used at home

exemplars.description: Identify and name items like buckets, plates, stools.
Discuss the uses of these items and improvise their use.

indicators.description: Recognise and discuss things used at school

exemplars.description: Identify items in the school environment (e.g., chalk, books).
Describe the items and their uses in groups.

indicators.description: Demonstrate how some of the items used at home and in school are maintained

exemplars.description: Demonstrate maintenance of items found at home and school.
Discuss the benefits of maintenance.

subStrands.title: Talking about Oneself, Family, People and Places
subStrands.description: Demonstrating courtesy through expressions and behavior.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge on the recognition of expressions and behaviour that show courtesies

indicators.description: Demonstrate and say expressions that show courtesy

exemplars.description: Identify courteous expressions from a video (e.g., 'Please', 'Thank you').
Demonstrate courteous behavior in various situations.

indicators.description: Demonstrate non-verbal behaviour that depict courtesy

exemplars.description: Demonstrate and discuss non-verbal actions of courtesy.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge on understanding and use of polar question markers

indicators.description: Recognise and use polar question markers

exemplars.description: Form questions and identify polar question markers (e.g., Yes/No questions).

indicators.description: Explain and use polar question markers

exemplars.description: Use polar question markers correctly in speech and conversation.
Identify where markers occur in sentence structure.

subStrands.title: Giving and Following Commands/Instructions
subStrands.description: Using landmarks for directions and understanding home cleaning.

contentStandards.description: Exhibit knowledge of understanding and use of landmarks in giving directions

indicators.description: Recognise landmarks in your area and other areas

exemplars.description: Identify landmarks on a sketch and in the community.
Give directions to home using landmarks.

indicators.description: Use landmarks to give directions

exemplars.description: Give directions from one point to another on a sketch using landmarks.
Use GPS/digital address systems.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate an understanding of the process of cleaning the home

indicators.description: Discuss things that make the home unclean

exemplars.description: Identify items that make the home unclean (e.g., rubbish, stagnant water).

indicators.description: Discuss the items used in cleaning the home

exemplars.description: Identify and demonstrate use of cleaning items (e.g., broom, mop).

indicators.description: Give reasons for cleaning the home

exemplars.description: Discuss consequences of an unclean home and reasons for cleaning (e.g., health).

strands.title: Reading
strands.description: Developing reading skills through phonics, vocabulary, comprehension, and fluency.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate the ability to listen to and pronounce words with identical sounds from a list of words

indicators.description: Read and recognise words with familiar sounds

exemplars.description: Form words using specific sounds.
Identify words with similar sounds in poems.

indicators.description: Read and recognise diagraphs in words found in paragraphs

exemplars.description: Group words with and without diagraphs.
Identify diagraphs in words and use them to form new words.

indicators.description: Blend two or more syllables to form words and read them

exemplars.description: Divide words into syllables and use them to form new words.

indicators.description: Recognise and say consonant clusters in words found in paragraphs

exemplars.description: Identify words with consonant clusters in a paragraph.

subStrands.title: Vocabulary (Sight and Content Vocabulary)
subStrands.description: Reading aloud with correct pronunciation and tone.

contentStandards.description: Show an understanding of recognising and reading about things in their environment

indicators.description: Read paragraphs of passages aloud with correct pronunciation and tone

exemplars.description: Read sentences and paragraphs aloud in groups and individually.

indicators.description: Read stories aloud with correct pronunciation and tone

exemplars.description: Read sample texts and stories in groups.

contentStandards.description: Exhibit knowledge of answering questions based on texts presented

indicators.description: Explain the meaning of unfamiliar words in context

exemplars.description: Identify and explain unfamiliar words from a passage.

indicators.description: Answer factual and inferential questions

exemplars.description: Read a passage and answer factual and inferential questions.

subStrands.title: Silent Reading
subStrands.description: Reading for comprehension and understanding figurative expressions.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge on reading for comprehension

indicators.description: Explain the meaning of unfamiliar words in a text

exemplars.description: Read silently and explain unfamiliar words.

indicators.description: Explain the meaning of figurative expression in a text and answer questions on the passage

exemplars.description: Identify and explain figurative expressions in a passage.
Answer questions based on the passage.

subStrands.title: Fluency
subStrands.description: Reading longer texts with minimal mistakes.

contentStandards.description: Exhibit the ability to read longer texts with minimal mistakes

indicators.description: Read longer texts with minimal mistakes

exemplars.description: Read longer passages aloud and discuss unfamiliar words.

indicators.description: Read naturally

exemplars.description: Read longer passages silently with minimal mistakes.

subStrands.title: Summarising
subStrands.description: Summarising texts and identifying main ideas.

contentStandards.description: Show an understanding of how main ideas are extracted from a text

indicators.description: Give the summary of longer texts

exemplars.description: Recognise and write down main ideas from paragraphs.
Give summaries orally and in writing.

indicators.description: Write main ideas in a given text

exemplars.description: Select and write main ideas from a text in simple sentences.
